searchText: Good morning. Could someone clarify: Do we need 524288 Ether or 16384 validators for genesis? Or both? Asking because I see enough Ether but only 15k deposits. 16384 validators. We've currently activated at least 115% of that (18844 validators) if you follow MainNet chain head but only 88% of it if you respect the 2048 block follow distance. Aha ok! 👌
